company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held transportation and software company headquartered in Kraków, Poland. It provides long-distance bus and passenger-rail travel across Central Europe, supported by online booking, trip tracking and travel extras. Its asset-light model combines regional operating partners with Corvale’s own booking platform, network planning and brand. The company is expanding its rail service and investing in data and machine learning.

Founded by transport and software professionals, Corvale describes itself as engineering-led: teams take end-to-end ownership of their systems, and technology is central to improving how people travel. Its stated values are **Lead, Shape, Own, Enjoy the journey**. The company also highlights sustainability, shared goals, career ownership and collaborative problem-solving.

Corvale’s culture is described as fast-moving, open to new ideas and collaborative, with international teams and a focus on professional development, employee appreciation and work-life flexibility. It says it acts on employee feedback; technology roles may offer hybrid work and, in some cases, contractor arrangements.

results.title: Corvale Mobility wins regional workplace culture awards | Corvale
results.content: Corvale Mobility received several workplace culture awards based on an anonymous employee survey. Categories included innovation, work-life flexibility, purpose and values, professional development and employee appreciation. The people team said employees describe the culture as collaborative, fast-moving and open to new ideas, and that it will keep acting on survey feedback.

results.title: About Corvale Mobility
results.content: Corvale Mobility runs long-distance buses and a growing passenger-rail service in Central Europe. It uses an asset-light model: regional partners operate many routes while Corvale runs the booking platform, network planning and brand. Corvale has ordered a new train fleet to enter service later this decade, and scaling data and machine-learning use across the platform is a strategic priority.
